title: Playing Devil’s Advocate: Unmasking Toxicity and Vulnerabilities in Large Vision-Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting LVLMs with U.S. politics memes (HVVMemes dataset) using persona modulation strategies (e.g., 'Social Identity Attacks' to simulate extremist personas), followed by toxicity measurement using the Perspective API and thematic topic modeling using BERTopic.

Evaluating LVLM responses to the Hateful Memes dataset by measuring the 'Identity Attack' score via the Perspective API and conducting thematic analysis (BERTopic) to identify explicit topics like 'Racial and Criminal Stereotypes' and 'Ethnic Offensiveness'.

Analyzing toxic model outputs generated from adversarial multimodal prompts using topic modeling (BERTopic) to isolate and identify specific themes such as 'Violence and Feminism', 'Transphobic Language and Controversies', and 'Sexual Orientation and Moral Judgments'.

Performing thematic analysis (BERTopic) on highly toxic model responses to identify specific clusters related to religious offensiveness (e.g., anti-Muslim content) after subjecting models to hateful meme prompt completions.
